Coram:

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition seeks quashing of FIR No.179/2013 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC with P.S.
Kanjhawala basis settlement dated 5th February 2024, which is on record of this Court.
2. Petitioner nos. 1 to 4 and respondent no.2 complainant are present in the Court and are duly identified by the IO and the counsel.
3. Respondent no.2 states that settlement amounts have been received by her and now nothing is due and outstanding.
4. Marriage of petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 resulted in divorce dated 3rd June 2024.
One male child was born out of this wedlock.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.179/2013 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC with P.S. Kanjhawala and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
